tagline: Software engineer with a strong foundation in data structures, object-oriented design, and database systems, and particular depth in full-stack MERN development.
bio: I am a software engineer with a strong foundation in data structures, object-oriented design, and database systems, bringing particular depth in full-stack MERN development across React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Throughout my academic journey and independent projects, I have designed multi-service systems, including a deterministic recommendation engine and a role-based access-control platform, while also applying production experience across Java and C/C++.

Backed by an IBM certification in full-stack JavaScript development and hands-on experience through internships and technical training, I build scalable applications with modern tools. I work comfortably with Git and GitHub for version control, practice test-driven development, and focus on delivering clean, reliable software solutions.
